paite: TOUPA phat un! Van a kipante TOUPA phat unla; tunglamte ah amah phat un.
heading: Pathian Phat Dia Van Nuai Sapna

paite: Angel tengteng aw, amah phat unla; asepaih tengteng aw amah phat un!
Ni leh khate aw, amah phat unla; aksi vakte aw, amah phat un!
Vante' vante aw, amah phat unla, vante tung a tui omte aw, amah phat un!
Amaute'n TOUPA min phat uhen; ama'n thu apia a, siam in a-omta uhi.
Ama'n huaite tangtawn tangtawn a ding in ahihkip a; khen nawn theih louh ding in agite uh akhungkip hi.
Nou dragonte leh thuknate aw! Lei a kipan TOUPA phat un.
mei leh gial, vuk leh tuihute aw, athu zui zel huihpite!
Tangte leh mualte tengteng, singgah nuam leh sidar singte aw;
gamsate leh ganvulhte aw; ganhingte, tungleng vasate aw;
lei a kumpipate leh michih kumpi tate leh lei vaihawmte aw;
nungak leh tangvalte, putek leh naupangte aw, TOUPA phat un!
Amaute'n TOUPA min phat uhen; ama min kia tawisang in a-om ngal a; athupina in lei leh van akhup tham hi.
Amite a ding in kii atungdingta, amisiangthou tengteng a ding a phatna mah; amah kiangnai a om Israel mite a ding. TOUPA phat un!
